description: This file defines the OptionalFieldController class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, responsible for handling specific UI components related to optional fields. It extends an abstract controller and sets up a VueJS component during the preRender phase.

classes.name: OptionalFieldController
classes.description: Controller class for handling optional fields in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, extending the AbstractVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by initializing a Vue component named 'optional-field-list' and setting it via setComponent.
